_comment: The operator's own programs that use the GPU heavily (2026-10-22: 'dedicate ... 1 GPU core to whatever I want to do on my PC, like play Helldivers 2'). While any of these runs, a rig whose checks are about behaviour boots its game in LOW IMPACT beside it (minimum graphics, a low frame cap, a small window: src/engine/low_impact.rs), and a rig that judges the picture or times frames waits for it to close (2026-10-22 evening: 'I'd rather development testing continue if possible ... minimum graphics vs max'; which rig is which: scripts/lib/rig-needs.js). Add a program by its .exe name, lower case. Light programs (Discord, a browser playing YouTube) need no entry: a rig at 30 frames a second does not disturb them.
